title: ee.ask.v1
description: Deterministic extractive question answering with citations and honest abstention (ADR 0067, bd-169v0.1). Carried under ee.response.v2 data.answer. Every emitted answer sentence byte-equals a cited span of a stored memory — machine-checkable extractiveness invariant.

abstained.description: True when confidence < min_confidence (or corpus empty). Abstention is a SUCCESS response (exit 0), not an error. Exit 6 only under --require-confidence.

answerText.description: The composed extractive answer with [n] citation markers. Null when abstained or conflict_detected. Every sentence byte-equals a cited span.

confidence.description: Overall confidence: top_span_score × corroboration × (1 − contradiction_penalty), clamped to [0,1].

topSpanScore.description: Score of the highest-scoring cluster representative after corroboration.

contradictionPenalty.description: Penalty applied when top clusters oppose each other (0 = no conflict).

citations.description: Per-span citations; parallel to the [n] markers in answerText. Empty when abstained.

sides.description: Present in conflict mode. Each side is a self-contained extractive answer with its own citations.

nearestEvidence.description: Present when abstained. Top sub-threshold spans. Governor truncation point (ADR 0063).

counterfactualHint.description: Human-readable abstention reason mirroring why-not phrasing.

candidatesScanned.description: Number of memory candidates examined by the engine.

_semanticDegraded.description: True when the hash-embedder fallback was used (w2 renormalized into w1). Corresponds to the ask_semantic_degraded degradation code in the envelope.

_conflictDetected.description: True when the top evidence clusters oppose each other. Corresponds to ask_conflicting_evidence in the envelope.

byteStart.description: Inclusive byte offset in the stored memory content.

byteEnd.description: Exclusive byte offset in the stored memory content.

span.description: Byte range in the source memory. text MUST byte-equal content[byteStart:byteEnd].

text.description: Byte-equal copy of the cited span. Verifiable by byte comparison against the source memory.

provenanceUri.description: Provenance URI of the source memory.

trustClass.description: Trust class of the source memory.

label.description: Which side of the conflict this represents.

answerText.description: Extractive answer for this side with [n] citation markers.
